bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'HOST_PROJECT_ROOT='; git rev-parse --show-toplevel
printf 'HOST_PROJECT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT
printf 'LIVE_RUNNING='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT
printf 'LOCAL_IMAGE_ID='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || echo ABSENT
printf 'CHECKOUTS='; find /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/GateApp-Bot /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/GateApp-Bot/.worktrees -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | head -15 || true
